name: Jane App
description: Jane is practice-management software for health and wellness clinics. Clinics use it for online booking, schedules, patient records, charting, treatments, staff, billing, and day-to-day practice operations.
agentUseSummary: Enter the clinic's Jane URL and connect once through practitioner-approved OAuth, then choose which agents can use its authorized clinic and clinical data under Safe or Dangerous policy.

capabilities.label: Read clinic and clinical data
capabilities.description: Read company, locations, staff, appointments, treatments, disciplines, patients, observations, care plans, medications, and user-owned document uploads.

capabilities.label: Manage clinical records
capabilities.description: Create or update observations, care plans, activities, medications, and user-owned clinical document uploads.

allowed.label: Read Jane App
allowed.description: Run one of 23 current practitioner-authorized clinic or clinical read operations.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Jane App
approvalRequired.description: Run one of nine current practitioner-authorized clinical record or document mutations.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: OAuth credentials and provider-managed webhook signing secrets never enter agent-visible requests or results.

blocked.label: Access another clinic
blocked.description: Every request stays on the clinic origin bound into the practitioner OAuth token.

blocked.label: Call another endpoint
blocked.description: Relay permits the 32 current practitioner business operations; OAuth and webhook infrastructure remain connection-owned.

blocked.label: Run an unbounded transfer
blocked.description: Relay bounds queries, bodies, uploads, responses, redirects, nesting, and execution time.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Authorized reads and patient search run directly. Every clinical record or document change requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected practitioner-authorized business operation runs without Relay per-action approval. Clinic and practitioner authority, exact routes, bounds, credential protection, Jane limits, healthcare-data controls, and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts 32 clinic-bound Jane business operations and attaches practitioner OAuth credentials server-side.
Railway mounts 32 clinic-bound Jane business operations and attaches practitioner OAuth credentials server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Jane's Developer Platform is a vetted Technology Partner program. Relay has no approved production Jane Extension, partner client ID and secret, registered callback, granted production scopes, representative clinic data, or authorized live practitioner account.
providerSetup.nextAction: Apply through Jane Partnerships, register Relay Console with https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/jane-app/callback and the 18 current business scopes, store JANE_APP_CLIENT_ID and JANE_APP_CLIENT_SECRET in Railway, deploy, and verify clinic-bound connect, refresh, reads, Safe approval, Dangerous clinical mutation, revocation, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Jane documents partner approval, exact HTTPS callbacks, required PKCE and state, practitioner and clinic-bound OAuth, five-minute access tokens, refresh and revocation, and fixed clinic audiences.

Jane's official current reference index exposes 36 clinic API operations plus separate partner-extension administration; Relay maps all 32 practitioner business operations while retaining OAuth and webhook infrastructure at the connection boundary.
Jane states that its healthcare API program is approval-based, limited to vetted partners, and not open for clinics to independently publish integrations.
